q: By what nickname are Stoke City known?
hint: Stoke-on-Trent sits at the heart of the Potteries, the ceramics industry that defined the region.

q: Stoke City, founded in 1863, are among the oldest what?
o: Professional football clubs in the world
hint: Only a small handful of clubs anywhere can claim a longer continuous history.

q: Stoke City won their only major trophy in 1972. Which was it?
hint: They beat Chelsea 2-1 at Wembley; it remains the club's sole major honour.

q: Which legendary winger, the first Ballon d'Or winner, played for Stoke City in two spells?
hint: Matthews won the inaugural Ballon d'Or in 1956 and returned to Stoke aged 46, playing top-flight football past 50.

q: Which World Cup-winning goalkeeper was in Stoke City's 1972 League Cup-winning side?
hint: Banks, England's 1966 keeper, made the famous save from Pelé two years before joining the Stoke side that won at Wembley.

q: Stoke City's rivalry, the Potteries derby, is with which club?
hint: The two clubs are the only senior sides in Stoke-on-Trent, roughly three miles apart.

q: Which ground did Stoke City leave in 1997 after 119 years?
hint: It was one of the oldest grounds in the Football League when they moved to the new stadium at Trentham Lakes.

q: Stoke City became famous in the Premier League for which distinctive weapon?
o: The highest possession in the league
hint: Delap's flat, fast throws were treated as set pieces and became one of the most distinctive weapons of that era.

q: Stoke City reached the FA Cup final in 2011, losing to which club?
hint: Yaya Touré scored the only goal; it was Stoke's first FA Cup final and took them into the Europa League.

q: How long did Stoke City's uninterrupted Premier League spell last from 2008?
hint: They went up in 2008 and were relegated in 2018, an unusually long stay for a club of their resources.

q: What colours do Stoke City traditionally wear at home?
hint: The red-and-white stripe has been the club's identity for well over a century.

q: Which Spain international, a Champions League winner, joined Stoke City in 2016?
hint: Bojan came from Barcelona's academy and became a cult figure at the club, though injuries limited his impact.

q: Stoke City's 1972 League Cup final win came against which club?
hint: Stoke won 2-1 at Wembley through goals from Terry Conroy and George Eastham.

q: What is the name of Stoke City's home ground?
hint: It was called the Britannia Stadium from 1997 until a naming-rights change in 2016.

q: Stoke City qualified for the Europa League in 2011 by what route?
hint: Manchester City had already qualified for the Champions League, so the losing finalists took the European place.

q: Which manager took Stoke City into the Premier League in 2008 and to the 2011 FA Cup final?
hint: Pulis had two spells at the club and built the side around set pieces and physical strength.
